summary: AFTERGLOW is a cinematic lunar survival strategy game set at Shackleton Crater on the Moon. Players take command of Selene Outpost Alpha with only 18 hours to prepare for an incoming solar storm. Every decision matters: manage essential resources, protect crew members, maintain habitat systems, and undertake risky lunar exploration missions. Players experience the consequences of their choices through evolving mission conditions, crew reactions, and branching outcomes. The project combines interactive storytelling, resource management, and space-science education to help players understand the challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon. Its central idea is simple: every decision leaves a trace.
details:
AFTERGLOW is an interactive lunar survival strategy game designed to explore the challenges of establishing and maintaining a human outpost on the Moon.

The player takes the role of commander of Selene Outpost Alpha at Shackleton Crater. An approaching solar storm creates an 18-hour preparation window. During this time, players must manage critical resources such as oxygen, water, food, and power, monitor crew well-being, maintain habitat systems, and make difficult mission decisions.

The experience includes crew management, crisis scenarios, lunar EVA exploration, resource monitoring, mission objectives, and a mission chronicle that records the consequences of decisions. Different choices can lead to different mission outcomes, encouraging players to think strategically and understand the risks involved in lunar exploration.

The project is built using React, TypeScript, and Vite. AI-assisted development tools were used during implementation. The interface combines cinematic storytelling with interactive gameplay to make space exploration more engaging and accessible.

Our goal is to turn the science and challenges of lunar survival into an educational experience where players learn through decisions, consequences, and exploration.
